name: easygerber
description: AI PCB design, layout, and routing

walkthroughs.title: Design a PCB with EasyGerber
walkthroughs.description: Connect the hosted service, load the workflow, and build with published parts.

steps.title: Connect in VS Code Chat
steps.description:
Use Chat Agent mode with a tool-capable model. Find EasyGerber in MCP: List Servers and keep normal tool approvals enabled. Use one EasyGerber connection at a time.
[Integration documentation](https://easygerber.com/agents)

steps.title: Load the PCB workflow
steps.description: Enter /easygerber in Chat. Describe a small circuit and use published catalog parts with verified pins. Start one guest board without an EasyGerber account. Generate its layout, inspect the preview, and check for blocking issues before exporting.

steps.title: Keep board access private
steps.description:
Guest tokens, board links, and exports are private. Placement, routing, and scoring run on EasyGerber servers. Account continuation uses native OAuth consent.
[Privacy policy](https://easygerber.com/privacy)
[Support](https://easygerber.com/agents)
